annotations.scope: Actual page Annots ownership, unique NM per page, same-page IRT and RT grouping relationships, parent/popup reciprocal ownership; shared resource object identity does not confer annotation ownership.

remoteActions.scope: GoToR and GoToE D versus SD destination branches, remote page integers, file requirements and recursively bounded target paths. No I/O or target-file existence inference.

rectilinearMeasures.scope: Normalized RL measure arrays, required units/format members, fractional denominator and origin/CYX relationships. Foreign Measure subtypes remain opaque; no universal positive-C or power-of-ten constraint is invented.

effectivePageAttributes.scope: Effective inherited integer quarter-turn Rotate; actual page production rectangles, positive UserUnit, edition-dependent Tabs; native and frozen incremental graphs.

effectiveOutlines.scope: Actual catalog root; bounded reciprocal links and ownership, visible descendant Counts, C/F values, Dest/A exclusion, indirect SE. Frozen historical builders cannot alter old graph meaning.

activeActions.scope: Required entries and intrinsic value/version/flag contracts of standard active actions, actual annotation targets, registered OCG state operands, actual DPart tree targets, RichMedia target instances and script-only trigger locations. Unknown extension actions remain opaque. No action or external resource is executed.

richMediaContracts.scope: Required instance type; optional configuration type and unique decoded names; named asset relative-URI/F/UF identity; activation/deactivation, animation and window domains. Unnamed primary assets remain permitted by EC3 #58; unknown animation names retain their normative fallback.

boundaries: Handwritten effective-graph checks are distinct from generated dictionary schemas and from source annotation inventories. Neither their counts nor the presence of a catalogue entry proves global ISO conformity.

These checks do not execute actions/scripts/media, validate external target files or codecs, or establish semantic accessibility. Some further native action payload and target-name relationships remain separate mechanisms; see the source-linked audit.

developmentValidation.qualification: Run the current unit tests, static analysis and all CI oracles on the exact release candidate for PHP 8.3/8.4/8.5.
